visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: OR Instead of XOR
visualizerParams.problemDescription: In 2 3 2 4 4 the number 3 appears once, but the program prints 7.

solution.explanation: OR only ever sets bits, so equal values do not cancel out and the bits of every number pile up (2 | 3 | 4 = 7). XOR toggles bits, so a value that appears twice cancels itself.
